sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 17188 of 2022
Petitioner :- Bhupendra Kumar Maurya And 2 Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Nand Kishor Mishra,Shilpa Ahuja

Counsel for Respondent :- Birendra Singh,G.A.,Neeraj Dubey,Pankaj Dubey,Shriman Narayan 
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.
No one is present on behalf of the petitioners.

2. Heard learned counsel for the respondent No.4 and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
3.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 28.10.2022, registered as Case Crime No.395 of 2022, under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506, 377 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Ghoorpur, District-Prayagraj,
Bhupendra Kumar Maurya And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19552805/
1 and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
4.

entities.text: Bhupendra Kumar Maurya And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent No.4 informs that mediation in between the parties has failed.

5. Petition is disposed of directing that till cognizance is taken on police report under Section 173(2)
Cr.P.C., by the Court, the respondents shall not arrest the petitioners pursuant toFirst Information Report dated 28.10.2022, registered as Case Crime No.395 of 2022, under Sections- 498A, 323, 504,
506, 377 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Ghoorpur, District-Prayagraj, subject to cooperation in ongoing investigation.
